_about: THE DOCUSTAY FACTS FILE. Every public fact lives here and nowhere else. Edit it only with `plumb change`; then `plumb sync` regenerates everything and `plumb check` proves it. Money is whole cents (USD). Counts that live in code (templates, MCP tools, SDK languages, scopes, webhook events, settings) are computed at build time and are not listed here.

tagline.support: Open source and self-hostable. Pro is {pro} a month for your whole team: no per-seat fees, unlimited people and documents. Signers can pay while they sign, straight into your own Stripe account, and Pro adds no fee.
tagline.payAsYouGoLine: Pay as you go is {person} per person if you would rather pay per person.
tagline.pricingIntro: Start free. Pay as you go is {person} per person a month if you only send a few. Pro is {pro} a month for your whole team, with no seats. Every price is on this page, and a monthly budget means the bill never surprises you.

company.line: Docustay is a product of GLRS LLC

subProcessors.name: Stripe
subProcessors.data: Billing details and payment references; card numbers go to Stripe directly

subProcessors.name: Resend
subProcessors.data: Recipient email address and the message

subProcessors.name: Anthropic
subProcessors.does: The AI model behind Scribe and Find fields with AI
subProcessors.data: The text or page pictures of a document, only when a person uses an AI feature, and only for that request

subProcessors.name: Cloudflare
subProcessors.does: Delivery of the website and the signing pages, and the bot check on the sign-up page
subProcessors.data: The visitor's address and browser. Page traffic passes through it in transit

subProcessors.name: PostHog
subProcessors.data: Events about how the website and the service are used, tied to an account id, never document content

subProcessors.name: Google Analytics
subProcessors.does: Website visit statistics, only after you press Accept in the cookie choice
subProcessors.data: Page visits and a browser identifier, never document content or signer details

subProcessors.name: A public time-stamp authority (DigiCert by default)
subProcessors.does: Trusted timestamp on a signed file
subProcessors.data: A hash of the document only, never its contents

ownServerTools: Umami (website visit counts, on our own server, not a sub-processor)
_pricingNote: Pro is one price for everyone. The API keeps a deprecated `founders` field that is always false.

payments._about: Payments inside a document. Read from the code by `plumb check` (currencies from src/documents/flowDefinition.mjs, the hold from src/documents/pdfSigning.mjs, the guided-setup country from src/product/docustayStripeAccount.mjs); pages state them and plumb check compares.
